prices.description: prices per million tokens, by model name or name prefix: { "<model>": { "input": 3, "output": 15, "cacheRead": 0.3, "cacheWrite": 3.75, "currency": "USD" } } (currency defaults to USD). A price set for a model in /model (which can change by time of day) takes precedence; models without a price are counted in tokens only
